verdict.rationale: Latham publishes a free public Book of Jargon – Emerging Companies glossary on lw.com, available on the web, as iOS/Android apps and as a PDF. It covers founder-equity and seed terms such as 409A, 83(b), cliff vesting and SAFE. Its LathamDrive site offers a glossary, lawyer-answered FAQs and resources organized by stage (Formation, Capital Raising, and so on). Missing for 10: evidence of the actual FAQ and explainer content depth on financing and equity, confirmation that LathamDrive resources are openly accessible rather than gated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
